d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how France is strategically pushing to restore its military influence in Africa’s turbulent Sahel region, leveraging its historic relationship with Chad. Less than two years after military governments across West Africa expelled French forces and Chad abruptly severed its six-decade defence pact, Paris and N'Djamena are rebuilding security cooperation. After high-level talks between French President Emmanuel Macron and Chadian President Mahamat Idriss Déby, France is set to deploy Mirage 2000 fighter jets to Chad for upcoming joint military training…
